indication_area: Endocrinology (hyperglycemia secondary to endogenous Cushing's syndrome)
geography: United States (Corcept sells Korlym only in the U.S.; from June 2024 the line includes Corcept's authorized generic of Korlym)

launch_evidence.quote: For the second quarter of 2012, which was the first quarter with commercial sales of Korlym, Corcept recognized approximately $875,000 in net product sales, after deducting associated government rebates, chargebacks and other allowances.

search_log: Listed every filing of Corcept Therapeutics (CIK 1088856) via data.sec.gov/submissions; selected 8-Ks with item 2.02 (2012-04 to 2026-11) and every 10-Q/10-K; parsed every table row and, for releases filed through 2016 that set their statements as text rather than HTML tables, every text line.

Rows: 'Product sales, net' (to 2019Q2 except 2019Q1/Q4 releases) / 'Product revenue, net' of each quarter's own release, three-month column, Korlym being Corcept's only product through 2026Q1; 2026Q2 the 'Korlym and authorized generic' row, Lifyorli (approved March 2026; first sales 2026Q2 per the 2026Q2 10-Q six-month column) excluded. Where a quarter has both a January preliminary release and a full results release, the full results release (latest filed) is used.
Checks: each Q4 release prints the full-year figure, and the four quarters sum to it (verify_staged_manifests sum check).
